intro.p1: At Janazyan Projects, it is important to us that every customer is satisfied with their purchase and receives safe, high-quality care products in proper condition. If an issue arises with your order, we are ready to help you arrange an exchange or return.
intro.p2: Because our range includes care products for children, pregnant women, nursing mothers, and adults — including shampoos, body washes, SPF products, and other cosmetics — we pay particular attention to hygiene and safety requirements throughout the return and exchange process.

exchange.title: 1. Exchange
exchange.p1: Purchased products may be exchanged within 14 days from the date the order is received.
exchange.p2: An exchange is available only if the product:

items.packaging: is in complete and undamaged packaging;
items.seal: retains its protective film, cap, or factory seal, if originally provided.

exchange.p3: Proof of purchase must be provided for an exchange, such as a cash register receipt, electronic invoice, or order confirmation.
exchange.p4: If an incorrect product has been delivered to the customer, we will arrange an exchange for the correct product at no additional cost.

returns.title: 2. Returns
returns.p1: Purchased products may be returned within 14 days from the date the order is received, provided that they meet the return conditions.
returns.p2: A return is available only if the product:

items.packaging: is in its complete original packaging;
items.saleable: has retained its original saleable condition.

returns.p3: Proof of purchase must be provided for a return, such as a cash register receipt, electronic invoice, or order confirmation.
returns.p4: Opened or used care products, as well as products with damaged packaging, are not eligible for return for hygiene and safety reasons, except where there is a manufacturing defect or an incorrect product was delivered by us.

refunds.title: 3. Refunds
refunds.p1: If the returned product meets the conditions stated above, the refund will be issued using the same payment method used for the original purchase.
refunds.p2: For card payments, a refund may take up to 7 business days, depending on the bank’s procedures.
refunds.p3: Delivery fees are non-refundable, except where we delivered an incorrect product or the product was damaged due to our actions or those of the delivery service.

cancellation.title: 4. Order Cancellation
cancellation.p1: An order may be canceled before it is handed over for delivery.
cancellation.p2: If the order has already been transferred to the delivery service or delivered to the customer, it cannot be canceled. In that case, the return or exchange conditions may apply, provided that the product meets the requirements stated above.

nonEligible.title: 5. Products Not Eligible for Return or Exchange
nonEligible.description: The following products are not eligible for return or exchange:

items.seal: products from which the protective film has been removed or the factory seal has been broken;
items.custom: custom orders or special sets assembled according to the customer’s individual request;
items.giftCards: gift cards, if offered for sale.

damaged.title: 6. Damaged or Incorrectly Delivered Products
damaged.p1: If you receive a product in damaged condition, the packaging is damaged, there is leakage, or an incorrect product is included in the order, please contact us as soon as possible.
damaged.p2: To help us review the issue promptly, please provide:

items.photos: photos of the product and its packaging;
items.description: a brief description of the issue.

damaged.p3: In such cases, we will review the situation and offer the most appropriate solution: a product exchange, a return, or another mutually agreed option.

reactions.title: 7. Individual Reactions During Use
reactions.p1: The effects of care products may vary depending on individual skin characteristics. If you experience discomfort, irritation, or an allergic reaction during use, we recommend discontinuing use of the product and consulting a specialist if necessary.
reactions.p2: A used product is not eligible for return or exchange unless it has a manufacturing defect or there is an issue related to delivery.
reactions.p3: Janazyan Projects values the trust of every customer and is ready to provide support with any questions, ensuring honest, clear, and responsible communication.
